Every investigation has a final chapter, but the answers don't always come easily. Join Josh Gates as he follows the last leads, pieces together the evidence and pushes each expedition towards its conclusion. Will the final clues finally solve the mysteries, or will some questions remain unanswered?
Watch Expedition Unknown, S8, Episodes 11, 6, 2, 1, 16, 3 & 9 on Discovery Channel India.
